title: Small Things Like These
description: A small Irish town by a river, the week before Christmas. Bill Furlong delivers coal to the convent on the hill, and one morning finds a girl locked in its coal shed. What will he do for her — and what will it cost his own house?
line: The coal shed’s bolt is drawn from the outside, and a girl has spent the night on the coal: what will a decent man do for her, and what will it cost him?
source: after the novella by Claire Keegan
